The vendor row is a misdated event. The stock rose 12.2% on the release day and peaked at 90p; it has since slipped to 86.35p. An IMC retail presentation of results already published does not carry new price-sensitive information under MAR Article 17 selective-disclosure rules, so I have no signed finding, p_up is 50 and abs_move_pct is a 70%-vol AIM name's ordinary session (about 3.5%).
